html:
Russian leader, born in Leningrad in 1952, who has ruled Russia as president or prime minister since 1999.

He served in the KGB, the Soviet secret police, partly in East Germany. After the Soviet Union dissolved he worked for the mayor of Saint Petersburg. In 1999 Boris Yeltsin made him prime minister, and on the last day of that year, when Yeltsin resigned, acting president.

  • He led the brutal Second Chechen War.
  • In his first years high oil prices brought growth, while he brought the media and rich businessmen under his control.
  • Barred from a third straight term, he served as prime minister from 2008 to 2012, then returned as president.
  • He fought a short war with Georgia in 2008 and annexed Crimea from Ukraine in 2014.
  • In February 2022 he launched the full invasion of Ukraine (Russia invades Ukraine).

Elections under him are not free, critics have been jailed or killed, and changes to the constitution in 2020 let him stay in power to 2036. The International Criminal Court issued a warrant for his arrest in 2023.
